# Quick Web Notepad

> Quick Web Notepad is a free, open-source (MIT) notepad that runs entirely in your browser at https://quickwebnotepad.com/ : no account, notes are not uploaded to a server, and it works offline as an installable web app.

- Plain-text editor; opens and saves local files (saves in place in Chromium desktop browsers, otherwise downloads a copy); a file dropped on the page is opened
- Find and replace with match case and regular expressions
- Read-only Syntax view (JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, JSON, SQL, shell, C, Markdown) and read-only Markdown preview (GitHub Flavored Markdown tables, task lists, code blocks)
- Lock mode, light and dark themes, zoom, word wrap, keyboard shortcuts
- Each tab's text survives a reload; a new tab starts empty; notes from closed tabs stay in the browser (localStorage, up to 30) and can be reopened or deleted from the Recent menu; nothing syncs between devices
- Interface in 15 languages: English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Thai, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian
- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no build step
- The site shows Google AdSense ads, including one thin strip under the editor; it runs no separate analytics tool

## For AI agents and browser automation
- Hand a result to the user: open `https://quickwebnotepad.com/#text=<encodeURIComponent(text)>&name=report.md&view=markdown`. Optional: `view=markdown|syntax|edit`, `lock=1`. The text is after the `#`, so it is not sent to any server; at most 500,000 characters. The user reads the report formatted; every code block has a Copy button, so put anything the user must copy (commands, links, values) in fenced code blocks.
- Script it: `window.qwn.getText()`, `.setText(text)`, `.append(text)`, `.setName('notes.md')`, `.setView('markdown')`, `.getState()`, `.save()`.
- Read state: `<html data-view="edit|syntax|markdown" data-locked="true|false">`; the last status message stays in `#lastStatus`.
- Stable controls: `#editor` (textarea), `#bOpen`, `#bSave`, `#bCopy`, `#bClear`, `#bFind`, `#bMarkdown`, `#bSyntax`, `#bLock`, `#bRecent`, `#fileName`, `#fileExt`, `#fileInput` (upload a file here to open it). Each button has an aria-label in the interface language.
- No native dialogs: confirmations are in-page buttons. Under automation (`navigator.webdriver`), Open uses `#fileInput` and Save downloads the file, so no system file dialog appears.
- Careful: pressing Esc twice clears the text (three times when locked). An Undo button (`#bUndo`) restores it until the next edit.
